description: This header file declares the class SystemModeImplementation, which implements the Exchange::ISystemMode interface. It manages system mode states, client activation/deactivation, and maps system modes and device optimize states to strings within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: SystemModeImplementation
classes.description: Implements the ISystemMode interface, manages system modes and device states, handles client activation/deactivation, and maintains internal mappings and synchronization.

methods.name: RequestState
methods.description: Requests a change to a specified system mode and state.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified system mode.

methods.name: ClientActivated
methods.description: Handles client activation for a given callsign and system mode.

methods.name: ClientDeactivated
methods.description: Handles client deactivation for a given callsign and system mode.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the SystemModeImplementation instance.
